TARIFF STRESS TEST | G4-G6 | Reacceleration, 2025
|
|-- Exposure: management's Q3 2025 account
|   |-- [S] Cross-border GMV = 15% of total.
|   |-- [S] US inbound/outbound = roughly half of that share.
|   `-- [I] Implied US-linked cross-border GMV: ~7.5% of total.
|       [I] This is not an estimate of tariff-affected GMV.
|
|-- Response: tools for merchant adaptation
|   |-- [S] Q1 2025: enhanced duty/tax collection through Managed Markets.
|   |-- [S] Other markets can be managed independently.
|   |-- [S] Management says merchants can adapt to new duties within hours.
|   `-- [S] Shop added a country filter to help buyers find local products.
|
|-- Observation -[assoc]-> resilience, not an identified tool effect
|   |-- [S] Q3 2025: US inbound/outbound demand remained relatively steady.
|   `-- [I] No counterfactual separates tools, merchant actions and demand.
|
`-- Seed claims without matching pinned tariff excerpts
    |-- [S] China de minimis imports ~1% of GMV (seed-only).
    |-- [S] Anticipated Q2 tariff impact did not materialize (seed-only).
    `-- [I] Retain as management claims, not verified impact estimates.
